title: Backoffice users, groups, and permissions after a migration
description: Backoffice users and permissions that can come out of a major database migration wrong: groups, start nodes, section access, and administrator accounts.

impact.summary: User and group data is converted by the database migration and needs a check per group.

handling.option: Check login and a typical task for each user group after each database step; fix through the backoffice; never record passwords

sources.evidence: Users are people who have access to the Umbraco backoffice

checks.text: A user of each group logs in and completes a typical task on the local copy
